column1: # mapping_set_title: "GDSC reusable KoboToolbox authoring form to Science-on-Schema.org"

# mapping_set_description: "Reusable, record-number-agnostic SSSOM mapping from the KoboToolbox metadata authoring form (vector/raster/table) to Science-on-Schema.org JSON-LD. Field-level union of the form schema; conditional vector-only and raster-only rows no-op harmlessly when absent. AI-assisted authoring; human curation required."
